messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Shiny 0.11.1
parts:
Shiny 0.11.1 is on CRAN and binaries are available for all platforms. This is a maintenance release that fixes a number of bugs.

The important fixes include:
* Major client-side performance improvements for pages that have many conditionalPanels, tabPanels, and plotOutputs. (#693, #717, #723)
* Slider problems in IE 11 and Chrome on touchscreen-equipped Windows computers have been fixed. (#700)

For a full list of changes, see the NEWS file:
  http://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/shiny/NEWS


-Winston
